subject: Theatre Arts
provisional_note: Semester 1 (Jul-Dec 2026) follows the official MoEST 2026 calendar. Semester 2 (Jan-May 2027) is inferred from the 2026 pattern and ends before the ACSEE examinations - replace it with the published 2026/2027 almanac before relying on those dates.

entries.main_competence: 1.0  Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts, theories and principles of theatre arts
entries.specific_competence: 1.1  Demonstrate an understanding of the development of theatre arts and its major trends
entries.learning_activity: (a)  Describe the major trends in the development of theatre worldwide (naturalism, realism, symbolism, expressionism and theatre of the absurd)
teaching_learning_activities: ICT-based learning: Guide students to use mobile application and web-based learning to search on the major trends in the development of theatre worldwide
Think-ink-pair-share: Guide students into collaborative learning in answering questions based on the major trends in the development of theatre worldwide
Snow-balling: Guide students to summarize the major trends in the development of theatre worldwide
entries.assessment: Major trends in the development of theatre worldwide well described
resources: Videos of theatre arts movements and trends
entries.references: TIE, Theatre Arts for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0  Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts, theories and principles of theatre arts
entries.specific_competence: 1.1  Demonstrate an understanding of the development of theatre arts and its major trends
entries.learning_activity: (b)  Explain the major trends in the development of theatre in Africa (theatre for social change)
teaching_learning_activities: ICT-based learning: Guide students to use mobile application and web-based learning to search the major trends in the development of theatre in Africa
Case study: Organize students into conducting depth examination and analysis to distinguish theatre for social change events from other events and situation
entries.assessment: Trends in the development of theatre in Africa well described
resources: Videos of theatre arts movement and trends
entries.references: TIE, Theatre Arts for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0  Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts, theories and principles of theatre arts
entries.specific_competence: 1.2  Demonstrate an understanding of the history and principles of scriptwriting, acting and directing
entries.learning_activity: (a)  Explain the emergence and development of scriptwriting for stage, film, radio and television
teaching_learning_activities: ICT-based learning: Guide students to use mobile application and web-based learning to understand the development of scriptwriting for stage, film, radio and television
Group discussion: Help students to actively contribute to the discussion of emergence of scriptwriting for stage, film, radio and television

entries.specific_competence: 1.2  Demonstrate an understanding of the history and principles of scriptwriting, acting and directing
entries.learning_activity: (b) Describe principles of scriptwriting for stage, film, radio and television
teaching_learning_activities: ICT-based learning: Guide students to use mobile application and web-based learning to explore theories of scriptwriting
